label: Judicial and administrative adjudication estate
domain: court dockets, bid protests, agency adjudications, appeals, settlements, bankruptcy, and dispositive instruments
scope: Federal and administrative adjudication systems that can confirm, reject, narrow, stay, dismiss, settle, or otherwise dispose of procurement, regulatory, corporate, property, employment, and public-law disputes. The estate preserves case identifiers, party identities, docket chronology, outcomes, appeal posture, sealed or unavailable coverage, and unsuccessful paths.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A filing, protest, allegation, or open docket is not a finding. Outcome labels require the operative decision and current appeal or settlement posture.

next_acquisition.operation: freeze party- and instrument-level adjudication denominators and recover dispositive records
next_acquisition.decisive_output: case-by-case ledger of parties, forum, filing, docket, disposition, appeal posture, operative instrument, and explicit no-case controls
source_routes: Court of Federal Claims opinions and dockets
